messages:
maria: quick ask 1 copy + a11y pass on the 'Stop instance' modal for Dedicated pools. users confused about running jobs and volumes. screenshot attached in thread. oliver: current modal is vague: header 'Stop instance' body 'Stop this instance?' primary 'Stop' autofocus. not ideal. anika: agree, too terse. could be mistaken for pause/restart. maria: goals: 1) make consequences explicit (jobs, billing, volumes), 2) keep button text concise, 3) provide easy safe alternative (snapshot), 4) ensure focus defaults away from destructive action.a11y-bot: accessibility notes: never autofocus destructive primary, tie aria-describedby on the primary to the explanatory paragraph, consider role="alertdialog" if data loss is irreversible, and check color contrast for destructive button state. oliver: copy variants: Short body: 'This will stop compute and end running jobs.' Explicit body: 'Stopping the instance cancels running jobs, detaches attached volumes (data remains), and stops compute billing. This cannot be undone.' Which do we prefer? anika: go explicit in body but keep the button label short: 'Stop instance' with an aria-label that spells out 'Stop instance and cancel running jobs'. maria: also add inline link 'How snapshots work' and an inline action 'Create snapshot' so folks can quickly preserve work. move 'Create snapshot' before 'Stop instance' in visual order.a11y-bot: recommended focus order: initial focus on Cancel (or close), then Create snapshot, then Stop instance. ensure the snapshot action is a button with aria-live polite region for status, and that the docs link has descriptive link text. oliver: final draft for devs to implement below. please review small wording nits: ```
Stop instance

Stopping this instance cancels any running jobs, detaches attached volumes (your data remains unless you delete it), and stops compute billing. This action cannot be undone. Learn about snapshots and data retention.

``` anika: two tiny copy nits: 1) change 'stops compute billing' -> 'stops compute billing charges' sounds off, keep 'stops compute billing'. 2) prefer 'cancels' over 'kills'. maria: ok locking on this. product please add i18n keys: modal.stop.title, modal.stop.body, modal.stop.primary, modal.stop.snapshot, modal.stop.cancel. dev-bot: i'll add unit tests asserting aria-describedby present and focus default is Cancel. a11y-bot: follow-up: run screen reader smoke test in staging after merge and verify contrast of the red button meets WCAG AA. oliver: noted. i'll update the figma and open a PR with the copy and a11y checklist. maria: thanks team 1 will mark resolved after PR lands and staging checks pass. :white_check_mark:
